profile.headline: Software Engineer at Bosch
profile.summary: Experienced Account Manager with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Python, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Java, Microsoft Word, C++, and HTML.

positions.title: System Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led porting of embedded software features including Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB), Automatic Brake Pre-Fill, and Emergency Hazard Lights to be used on 100k+ vehicles
• Translated OEM functional specifications into modular C/C++ software architectures for safety-critical braking systems for 4 different vehicle platforms
• Developed unit-level and system-level validation strategies to ensure compliance with ISO 26262 automotive safety standards
• Collaborated with systems, hardware, and validation teams to deliver production-ready ADAS functionality
• Resolved 34% of open defects within the ADAS cluster through root cause analysis and software fixes
• Defined and documented ASPICE Level 2-compliant software requirements for Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB), ensuring traceability from OEM specifications to implementation within the DOORs tool
• Developed and validated Automatic Emergency Braking logic ensuring compliance with NHTSA Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) 127 for MY29 vehicles
• Performed vehicle-level testing and diagnostics using Vector CANalyzer to monitor and analyze CAN bus traffic for brake system functionality.

positions.title: Integration Engineer
positions.description:
• Packaged electrical and software-controlled modules across multiple vehicle platforms
• Designed architecture and routing for low- and high-voltage wiring harness systems
• Led a team of 11 CAD designers to develop manufacturable wiring harness routings across complex vehicle systems
• Partnered with cross-functional teams to resolve packaging and integration challenges during vehicle development
• Coordinated cross-functional vehicle mockups with engineering teams to validate packaging constraints and wiring harness routing integrity.

positions.title: Performance Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed programs written in Java that manipulated clients in a database.

positions.title: Performance Tester
positions.description:
• Developed Java-based tools to manage and manipulate database accounts for testing environments
• Contributed to performance testing frameworks used to assess stability and scalability of the Applied Epic platform.
